steps.message: The second build did not fail. errors.log is empty and the log ends with 'Build succeeded'. The reduced output is because CoreCompile (and the app-host copy step) were skipped -- MSBuild determined their outputs were already up-to-date with the inputs from the first build, so it didn't recompile or relink anything.

The second build did not fail -- this is expected, correct incremental-build behavior for back-to-back builds with no source changes in between, not a hang and not a silent failure. The binlog's proof is the diagnostic-verbosity line 'Skipping target "CoreCompile" because all output files are up-to-date with respect to the input files' (plus the same for the app-host copy step): MSBuild reused the first build's outputs instead of recompiling, so errors.log is empty and the log ends with 'Build succeeded'. If you want to force a full rebuild for comparison, use dotnet build -t:Rebuild or clean obj/bin first.
